summary: The 32-bit board in an Ender 3's electronics box: an STM32 and four stepper drivers. Over its micro-USB it speaks G-code to whatever streams a print to it. This entry has the USB socket and not yet its motor, heater and endstop headers.

jacks.name: usb
jacks.label: USB
jacks.note: G-code in, and temperatures and progress out, through the board's USB serial bridge.
